reading.ru: Боже, Тебе подобает хвала на Сионе
reading.question: Where is praise appropriate to offer to God?
reading.explain: The text explicitly states 'хвала на Сионе' (praise on Zion)

reading.ru: Ты слышишь молитву, к Тебе придут все люди
reading.question: Who comes to God according to this verse?
reading.explain: The text says 'к Тебе придут все люди' (all people will come to You)

reading.ru: Блажен тот, кого Ты избрал и приблизил, чтобы он жил при Твоем святилище
reading.question: What privilege is given to those chosen by God?
reading.explain: The text says the blessed one is one 'чтобы он жил при Твоем святилище' (that he may live in Your sanctuary)

reading.ru: Ты отвечаешь нам устрашающими делами, даруя избавление
reading.question: How does God answer His people?
options: With awesome deeds that bring deliverance
reading.correct: With awesome deeds that bring deliverance
reading.explain: The text says God 'отвечаешь нам устрашающими делами, даруя избавление' (answers us with awesome deeds, granting deliverance)

reading.ru: Ты надежда всех краев земли и самых дальних морей
reading.question: Who does God serve as hope for?
options: All the edges of the earth and distant seas
reading.correct: All the edges of the earth and distant seas
reading.explain: The text says 'Ты надежда всех краев земли и самых дальних морей' (You are hope for all edges of the earth and distant seas)

reading.ru: Все восклицает и поет от радости
reading.question: What is the response to God's provision?
options: All creation shouts and sings with joy
reading.correct: All creation shouts and sings with joy
reading.explain: The text says 'Все восклицает и поет от радости' (All shouts and sings with joy)
